answer: Make every identity pay a real, unforgeable cost before it earns. Rewards are the nectar that draws attackers, so each account must first produce genuine graded labour to taste any. Zero-cost spam then buys nothing: minting a thousand sybils across a dune of fresh keys still demands a thousand real units of work. The velvet-smooth path of cheap replication collapses once the entry toll scales linearly with the count of fakes.
